notes: לֹא … וְ → 'neither … nor': present negative takes the opening word, waw the closing (rule 14).
יְחַיֶּה → 'saved … alive' headed on the complement 'alive' (rule 44); 'saved' is the competing head.
לָקַח → 'took away' kept whole as the ASV's phrasal rendering of the plundering sense; the surplus-particle reading was considered and set aside.
